items.title: BESS Battery Storage Sites
items.text: Specialised cooling solutions for battery energy storage systems, ensuring optimal operating temperatures and preventing thermal runaway to protect critical energy infrastructure.

items.title: Commercial
items.text: Complete HVAC solutions for offices, hotels, restaurants, and commercial premises. From small retail units to large multi-storey office buildings.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Critical environment climate control for hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, and care homes. Full compliance with SHTM 03-01 and HTM standards.

items.title: Leisure
items.text: Climate control for gyms, swimming pools, hotels, spas, and leisure centres. Specialised in humidity control and ventilation for pool areas.

items.title: Data Centres / IT Cooling
items.text: Precision cooling for server rooms and data centres. Ensuring consistent temperatures to protect critical IT infrastructure and prevent downtime.

items.title: Retail
items.text: Comfortable shopping environments with energy-efficient air conditioning for retail stores, shopping centres, and showrooms.

items.title: Residential
items.text: Home air conditioning installations from single room solutions to whole-house systems. Quiet, efficient, and aesthetically pleasing wall-mounted or concealed units.
